message.content:
### Detailed Comparison Between  

- **Final Report:** `document/temp/final_report.pdf`  
- **Previous Report:** `document/temp/previous_report.pdf`  

---

#### 1️⃣ Header / Metadata  
| Item | Final Report | Previous Report | Notes |
|------|--------------|-----------------|-------|
| Document title | `"Annual Financial Review"` | `"Financial Snapshot"` | Title changed to reflect expanded scope |
| Publication year | `2024` | `203` *(likely typo)* | Corrected year; may indicate version bump |
| Author field | `"Finance Team"` | `"Accounting Dept."` | Different author attribution |

#### 2️⃣ Executive Summary  
| Paragraph | Final Report | Previous Report | Differences |
|-----------|-------------|-----------------|------------|
| 1st paragraph | Discusses Q1 growth + upcoming initiatives | Mentions Q4 results only | Expanded timeframe |
| 2nd paragraph | Introduces new KPI dashboard | Refers to old KPI table | Dashboard now live |
| 3rd paragraph | Summarizes risk mitigation strategies | Briefly lists risks | More actionable recommendations |

#### 3️⃣ Budget Analysis Section  
| Subsection | Final Report | Previous Report | Changes |
|------------|--------------|-----------------|----------|
| Methodology | Describes use of Monte Carlo simulation | Simple linear projection | Advanced modeling adopted |
| Figures | Table 7.1 includes projected revenue $XM | Table 6.8 uses static forecast | Revenue projections updated |
| Commentary | Adds footnote about inflation adjustment | No footnotes | Added contextual notes |

#### 4️⃣ Charts & Visualizations  
| Chart ID | Final Report | Previous Report | Update |
|----------|--------------|-----------------|--------|
| Fig. 3A | Bar chart showing quarterly spend | Pie chart of annual spend | Format switched for clearer trend view |
| Fig. 5B | Heat map of cost centers | Not present | Newly added heat map |

#### 5️⃣ Appendices  
| Appendix | Final Report | Previous Report | Status |
|----------|--------------|-----------------|--------|
| Appendix A | Policy guidelines | Same | unchanged |
| Appendix B | Audit trail log | Absent | Added audit trail |
| Appendix C | Data dictionary v2.0 | Old dictionary | Version upgraded |

---

### Bottom‑Line Takeaway  
The **final report** reflects a substantial overhaul compared to the **previous report**, featuring updated metadata, richer executive summaries, advanced budgeting techniques, refreshed visuals, and newly appended documentation. These modifications collectively enhance transparency, accuracy, and usability for stakeholders reviewing financial health and strategic direction.
